source.name: Gil Vicente FC: Gil Vicente FC e GoldenPark juntos até 2027
source.quote: com a GoldenPark.pt, que será o Main Sponsor da nossa equipa principal de futebol e que terá a sua marca estampada na frente das nossas camisolas.
source.note: English: with GoldenPark.pt, which will be the Main Sponsor of our main football team and will have its brand printed on the front of our shirts. Three-year deal signed in July 2024, running through 2026-27; the club store's photo of the 2026-27 home shirt shows 'GOLDENPARK.pt CASINO' across the front.

source.name: Gil Vicente FC, Loja Oficial: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The product's front photo (https://loja.gilvicentefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Sem-Titulo-1-1.png) shows 'H.M. MOTOR' on the right chest, above the Joma logo. The club's partners page (https://gilvicentefc.pt/patrocinadores/) lists H.M. Motor (hm-motor.com) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

source.name: Gil Vicente FC, Loja Oficial: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The product's back photo (https://loja.gilvicentefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Camisola-Principal-26-27_tras.png) shows 'BARCELOS' across the upper back, above the player's name. The club's partners page lists Barcelos (cm-barcelos.pt, the Município de Barcelos) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

source.name: Gil Vicente FC, Loja Oficial: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The product's back photo (https://loja.gilvicentefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Camisola-Principal-26-27_tras.png) shows 'RAIZE' across the lower back, below the number area. The club's partners page lists Raize (raize.pt) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

source.name: Gil Vicente FC, Loja Oficial: Camisola Principal 26/27
source.note: The product's front photo (https://loja.gilvicentefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Sem-Titulo-1-1.png) shows a 'Lu…' wordmark on the left sleeve and its back photo shows '…das' on the same sleeve; the wordmark matches Lusíadas. The club's partners page lists Lusíadas (lusiadas.pt) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

source.name: Gil Vicente FC, Loja Oficial: Calção Principal 26/27
source.note: The product's photo (https://loja.gilvicentefc.pt/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Calcao-Oficial-Principal-26-27-1.png) shows 'GRUPO MEGA.pt TECNOLOGIA' on the wearer's left leg of the blue home shorts. The club's partners page lists Grupo Mega (megaonline.pt) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Gil Vicente 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: Produced by Spanish sportswear brand Joma, the new Gil Vicente 2026-27 home shirt introduces a classic primary blue base
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. The club's partners page lists Joma as TECHNICAL SPONSOR.

summary: GoldenPark on the front (club announcement, 25 July 2024, a three-season deal), H.M. Motor on the right chest, Barcelos across the upper back, Raize on the lower back and Lusíadas on the sleeve of the Joma-made home shirt, with Grupo Mega.pt on the home shorts. Marked complete: the club store's product photos of the Camisola Principal 26/27 (front, back and side photos), of the Calção Principal 26/27 and of the Meia Principal 26/27 (socks, Joma logo only) show no other sponsor.
